blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Choco Mucho inched closer to clinching a bronze medal in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series after pouncing on a disheartened Nxled side, 25-14, 25-23, 25-22, on Saturday at Philsports Arena. Still licking the wounds of their semifinal exit, Sisi Rondina-Rosales led the Flying Titans to a strong bounce-back win to take Game 1 of their bronze series with an all-around game of 12 points and 11 excellent receptions. Rondina-Rosales delivered the clutch blows in the last two sets, while Eya Laure nailed the game-winning hit and finished with 11 points. “We had a really good start. […]...
